facts.fact: Adwave's benchmark guidance lists CPM at $15-35 for SMB-friendly platforms and $25-65 for premium inventory.
facts.quote: Expect $15-35 for SMB-friendly platforms, $25-65 for premium inventory

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance says a VCR target is 90% or higher for CTV.
facts.quote: Target 90%+ (CTV's big advantage over digital video)

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance says CPCV should be kept under $4 for healthy efficiency.
facts.quote: Keep it under $4 for healthy efficiency

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance describes 2:1 to 4:1 as a reasonable starting point for CTV ROAS, which varies by industry.
facts.quote: ROAS:** Varies by industry, but 2:1 to 4:1 is a reasonable starting point

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance says a 5-15% brand awareness increase is a strong brand lift result.
facts.quote: Brand lift:** 5-15% awareness increase is a strong result

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV ads typically achieve 90 to 97% video completion rates because most are non-skippable.
facts.quote: CTV ads typically achieve 90 to 97% video completion rates because most are non-skippable.

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV CPMs typically range from $20 to $40, with $25 a common benchmark for small business campaigns.
facts.quote: CTV CPMs typically range from $20 to $40, with $25 being a common benchmark for small business campaigns.

facts.fact: Adwave identifies high CPM as a problem when it exceeds $40 for SMB campaigns.
Adwave flags a VCR below 85% as a below-benchmark problem.
Adwave advises that brand lift needs 4 or more weeks to materialize.
facts.quote: Brand lift needs 4+ weeks to materialize

facts.fact: Adwave states that viewers need 3-5 exposures for recall.
Adwave states a good target is 3 to 5 impressions per household over a campaign period.
facts.quote: A good target is 3 to 5 impressions per household over a campaign period.

facts.fact: Adwave states most campaigns need at least 10,000 to 20,000 impressions in a market to achieve meaningful frequency.
facts.quote: Most campaigns need at least 10,000 to 20,000 impressions in a market to achieve meaningful frequency.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends building a personal baseline after running 2-3 campaigns, which it considers more relevant than industry averages.
facts.quote: Once you've run 2-3 campaigns, you'll have a personal baseline that's more relevant than any industry average.
